option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: #!/bin/bash # Stampare il path corrente echo "Current working directory: $(pwd)" # Fermare il servizio echo "Stopping carbonio-preview service..." ssh root@192.168.1.150 'systemctl stop carbonio-preview' # Trasferire i file del progetto echo "Transferring project files..." scp -r ./* root@192.168.1.150:/opt/zextras/common/lib/python3.10/site-packages/ # Riavviare il servizio echo "Starting carbonio-preview service..." ssh root@192.168.1.150 'systemctl start carbonio-preview' # Mostrare i log del progetto echo "Displaying logs..." ssh root@192.168.1.150 'journalctl -u carbonio-preview -f | grep -v "GET /health/ready/"'
